reasons: Set effectively separates the three required functional roles: Image 1 serves as the crop-identity overview (general field with young broadleaf seedlings), Image 2 provides agronomic close evidence (dense rows of corn/maize seedlings with product detail), and Image 3 tells the irrigation-system story (wide field scale, linear layout, showing product placement in a larger context).
Zero people is maintained across all images.

Although Images 1 and 3 feature very similar product props and background crops (broadleaf/young corn), the difference in camera angle (close-up vs. wide-scale) and the specific narrative role (product intro vs. field system layout) is sufficient to avoid the 'near-duplicate' hard reject threshold.

Image 2 introduces a different crop morphology (maize/corn) which enriches the set with botanically neutral beds and evidence for the irrigation system's application on different stages of plant growth.
